title: Workflow
description: A state machine over Operations. A run starts in initial. In each state, its Operations may run any number of times; only a transition moves the run, when the Operation it names completes or fails, optionally guarded by a value in that Operation's output or by the final state a sub-workflow ended in. A state may run one sub-workflow, or two or more workflows at the same time as parallel regions. A final state ends the run and has no transitions.

id.description: Kebab-case. Unique among the workflows of its behaviour document. all is reserved.

initial.description: The state a run starts in. One of states.

mainPath.description: The usual path, as an ordered list of state ids. It starts at initial, each state has a transition to the next (on an Operation, or waiting for its regions), and no state repeats. It may end at any state, final or not. A sub-workflow and a region declare their own. Optional; without it a reader may derive one.

name.description: A state that is not final names the work done in it, as a verb and a noun, such as Review findings. A final state names the outcome, such as Signed off. A record's status is its entity's state, not the workflow state's name.

operations.description: Operations of this behaviour document available in this state.

workflow.description: A workflow of this behaviour document this state runs.

workflows.description: Workflows of this behaviour document this state runs at the same time, each as a region with its own states from its own initial. The state's own Operations stay available while the regions run, and a transition on one of them leaves the state at once and ends every region. A region's transitions stay inside the region. A state has workflow or workflows, never both.

final.description: Ends the run. Defaults to false.

on.description: An Operation available in the state, the state's sub-workflow, one of the state's regions, or all, for every Operation of the state. A transition on a region waits until every region has reached a final state; any of the regions may be named, with the same meaning.

oneOf.description: A value in the output of the Operation the transition is on.
The final state the state's sub-workflow, or one of its regions, ended in.

workflow.description: The sub-workflow or region that ended in final. One of the state's workflows. Defaults to the transition's on.
